report.title: Frozen holdout report
report.description: Research comparison only. Every reserved task and candidate needs all repetitions from its first planned measurement, with the frozen runtime and evaluator. This action makes no provider calls and does not activate routing.
report.freezeNotice: The first complete report is saved permanently. Later runs and regrades cannot replace its measurements. The plan fixes 2,000 paired group resamples, equal group weights and 95% percentile intervals before results exist.
report.legacy: This older reservation did not freeze a report recipe. It cannot acquire one after exposure.
report.coverage: {{groups}} declared groups · {{fallbacks}} tasks used the frozen fallback
report.intervals: Exploratory intervals are conditional on the measured repetitions and unadjusted for multiple comparisons. Few groups can produce unreliable or degenerate intervals. Best fixed is selected again in each resample; the oracle uses observed per-task utility. Missing costs are never zero. Grader, independence and full workflow qualification are still required before promotion.

holdout.title: Freeze an independent evaluation plan
holdout.description: Select at least 8 held-out cases in 4 declared independent groups. The service rejects families already planned in any run or reserved by another evaluation. Predictions and comparator choices are frozen before outcomes.
holdout.reservation: Freezing permanently reserves the declared related families for this evaluation. It starts no work and grants no spending or dispatch approval. Quality floor: 500/1000. Every fixed candidate, the best fixed, persona, aggregate and oracle are required comparators.
holdout.pending: Choices are frozen. Grader qualification and workflow validation remain separate requirements.

learning.title: Learned selector
learning.description: Fit a task-based selector from saved measurements and inspect its recommendations. Training runs locally and makes no model calls.
learning.gate: Research preview. Grader qualification, independent family evaluation and workflow validation are still required before automatic dispatch.
learning.noCases: No published training cases in this class.
learning.requirements: Select at least 8 common cases across 2 declared independent groups and at least 2 candidates. Complete repetitions, matching runtimes and one role/context are required. Weights: quality 80%, speed 15%, cost 5%; unknown resources are omitted for all compared candidates.
learning.coverage: {{cases}} common training cases in {{groups}} declared groups. This is training coverage, not a quality approval.
learning.trainingEvidence: Inspect frozen training evidence (quality out of 1000)
learning.availabilityHint: Configurations come from saved measurements. Check only candidates you want to treat as available. This preview neither probes providers nor starts work.
learning.estimates: Regression estimates out of 1000, not calibrated success probabilities. Minimum predicted quality: 500.

reasons.research_prediction: Research recommendation; automatic dispatch is disabled.
reasons.research_explicit_pin: Explicit model choice retained; automatic dispatch is disabled.
reasons.untrained_work_class: This work class was not included in the fit.
reasons.training_family_or_group: This task shares a training family or group. No independent prediction is reported.
reasons.untrained_role_or_execution_context: This role or execution context was not included in the fit.
reasons.untrained_available_candidate: An available candidate was not included in the fit.
reasons.changed_candidate_runtime: A candidate runtime has changed since training.
reasons.explicit_pin_unavailable: The explicitly chosen model is unavailable.
reasons.below_quality_floor: No available candidate meets the predicted quality floor.

sections.testHint: Identity, routing class and dataset split. The class ties results to the work Distill delegates.
sections.taskHint: Everything the candidate sees: the prompt and public fixtures. Answers and checks stay hidden.
sections.evaluationHint: Objective evaluators are verified against known passing and failing outputs before publication.
sections.executionHint: Runs in a fresh session with a clean context, no tools and no network. Publishing freezes the prompt, fixtures, evaluator and environment; later edits create a new version.
sections.advanced: Advanced: role context, continuation and workflow

editor.authoredByHint: Comma-separated needles matched against candidate model and provider IDs. A candidate that helped write the test is excluded from its scores.
editor.structuredHelp: Entry state carries rootTaskId, stepId, parentStepId, fixtureSnapshotHash, conversationPrefix, previousReports and remainingBudgetSeconds. A workflow carries driverRevision and 2–4 steps with id, prompt and includePreviousOutput. Hashes are recomputed on save.
editor.leaveDescription: Your saved draft and published results remain available.
editor.carried: Only the evaluator changed: the earlier results were evaluated again with it, and the test keeps its measurements.

library.emptyHint: Create a test or import a definition to start collecting evidence.
library.seedHint: Synthetic seeds validate the pipeline; they are not evidence for a ranking.

tracker.passedByHint: Models that passed the case every repetition, out of the models with a complete cell on it. Below: the widest gap between two models' shares of passed repetitions (0% when every model did alike, 100% when one always passed and another never did), and the cells whose repetitions disagree.

selector.title: Selector against fixed models
selector.empty: No held-out case has a complete cell for every model yet.
selector.casesHint: Held-out cases of the class on which every model has a complete cell.

hints.selector: The model the selector picks for each case from training evidence and the case's facets, points out of 1000.
hints.best_fixed: The best single model on these cases.
hints.persona: The first model of the class's persona ranking.
hints.oracle: The best model of each case: the ceiling no selector can pass.

selector.gainHint: The selector's points over the best fixed model's. Until it is above zero the selector chooses no model anywhere.

results.empty: No attempts for this test yet.

run.title: Run benchmarks
run.description: Choose published tests and pinned configurations. Development tests are diagnostic only and do not affect rankings or training. The execution count and budget are checked before anything starts.
run.noPublished: Publish a test in Bench development before running it.
run.catchUpMissing: {{model}} is no longer available on this account. Choose a configuration below.
run.catchUpChanged: {{model}} no longer offers this effort, fast mode or billing. Choose a configuration below.
run.preview: Development preview. Excluded from the boards and the history chart.

modelRun.waitingSignIn: Waits for a running Grok test
modelRun.finishHint: Run of {{at}}, open until {{until}}: {{left}} tests to measure, {{restart}} of them again from the first repetition.
modelRun.measuredHint: Measured in full {{at}}: {{measured}} tests, every repetition. Repeating this measurement is unnecessary spending. Confirm with Measure again to save this result in history and start a new run at full cost.

runs.title: Runs and history
runs.description: Every frozen plan with its progress. Open a run to pause, resume or cancel it.

attention.restarted: The app restarted while a test was in flight. Resume: the run goes on with its other tests, and the lost one starts over.
attention.quota: The usage limit ran out. Resume when it resets, or cancel.
attention.signIn: The provider's sign-in expired. Sign in, then resume.
attention.failed: A test stopped on an error: {{reason}}. Resume to try it again, or cancel.
attention.unknown: A test did not finish. Resume to try it again, or cancel.
attention.window: Finish before {{until}}; after that the run is recorded as it stands.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Sealed output and evaluation revisions remain available independently of the live transcript.
evidence.blindReview: Model identity, measurements and transcript stay hidden until the rubric review is recorded.

boardDescriptions.overall: The mean of the class boards, points out of 1000. Higher is better.
boardDescriptions.class: {{label}} cases, points out of 1000: a case counts when every repetition passed, weighted by how fast and how cheaply it was solved against the best measurement of that case. Higher is better.

shares.reliability: Cases solved on every repetition, of the cases measured.
shares.speed: Mean share of the fastest solution over the solved cases: 100% at the record, 50% at twice its time.
shares.cost: Mean share of the cheapest solution over the solved cases: 100% at the record, 50% at twice its spend.

leaderboard.emptyHint: Publish a test and run it to collect evidence.

design.emptyHint: Run a creative brief; every rendering lands here for the judge panel.

import.title: Import a definition
import.description: Imported content becomes an editable draft. Import never runs setup commands.
import.publish: Publish definitions that validate (verifies evaluators against their references; never calls a model)
import.tooLarge: Choose a definition smaller than 8 MiB.

export.title: Export benchmark dataset
export.description: Writes the full outcome matrix and a versioned manifest. Account labels and credentials are excluded.
export.heldOut: Include held-out evaluation outcomes in this research export

releases.title: Pool releases
releases.description: The boards measure training and held-out tests from the newest release. Development tests stay outside the rating pool. A new, revised or archived test reaches the boards at the next release.
releases.name: Name
releases.empty: No release yet: the boards measure every live test.

schedules.title: Automatic retesting
schedules.description: Campaigns run only while Distill is open and stay disabled until you enable them. Missed work is shown; it never launches a catch-up burst.
schedules.missed: Missed while the app was closed. Enable again to schedule the next run.
schedules.budget: Each run: at most {{executions}} executions, each limited to {{seconds}} seconds.
schedules.optIn: Enable this campaign with the fixed plan and budget
schedules.discovery: Refresh models within the plan's provider and account
schedules.discoveryHelp: The selected run defines the calibration suite and native effort/fast settings. New candidates use reported native defaults; every retest creates a new frozen plan under these limits.
schedules.modelIds: Allowed new model IDs (comma separated; empty allows all in scope)
schedules.includeNew: Calibrate newly discovered models in this scope

routing.title: Selector evidence
routing.description: Read-only observations, coverage and freshness for declared candidates. The query never starts a model.
routing.availabilityUnknown: Current availability has not been verified

purposes.selector: Selector input (training data outside the target family)

routing.candidatesHint: Candidates come from earlier runs of the target. Mark the ones available right now; unmarked candidates are reported as unavailable.
routing.noCandidates: No earlier runs declare candidates for this test.
routing.protocol: {{missing}} missing outcomes · shared time limit {{seconds}} s

catalog.title: Model catalog
catalog.description: Vendor list prices, context windows and display names, each dated. Boards show the entry that applied when a row was measured.
catalog.history: A changed price or limit is a new entry with its own effective date; older measurements keep the entry that applied when they ran.

fields.needleHint: Lowercase text found in the bridge's model name or id, for example "opus 5.5".
fields.providerHint: Leave empty to match the model on every provider.
fields.sourceHint: Where the figures were read, for example the vendor's pricing page.

configuration.higherIsBetter: Higher is better on every board
configuration.missing: This configuration is not in the current selection.

statusHint.preliminary: Not ranked: a current case has no scored result yet, a run shortened a task's time limit, or this model's case set differs from the ranked models.
statusHint.retrospective: A retrospective estimate on today's case pool. It has no rank.
statusHint.excluded: This model helped author every current case, so it is not measured.
statusHint.untested: No case has run for this model yet.

history.title: Rating history
history.recalculatedDescription: Every point covers today's cases. Each case uses the newest result available at that date, scored with today's reviews; a case not yet measured then uses its first later result.
history.recordedDescription: Results and evaluations as they stood at each date. Coverage can differ between points.

campaign.title: Compare strategies
campaign.description: Compare the learned selector, training aggregate, persona preference and each fixed worker on complete workflows.
campaign.empty: Select a saved comparison to see its progress and results, or create one below.
campaign.noFits: First fit a selector from saved training results in Learned selector.
campaign.requirements: Use at least 8 unused held-out workflows from 4 independent groups. All fitted workers participate. Native validation checks scope, runtime and prior exposure.
campaign.noCases: No eligible held-out workflows for this fit.
campaign.noAccounts: No enabled account or CLI sign-in is available for this worker.
campaign.budget: {{policies}} strategies · {{trajectories}} workflows · up to {{executions}} model calls · {{timeout}} s per workflow
campaign.freezeNotice: Saving validates the plan and reserves these task families for this comparison without generating answers. Starting is a separate action; worker availability is checked during execution.
campaign.planSummary: {{cases}} cases · {{policies}} strategies · {{repetitions}} repetitions · up to {{executions}} model calls
campaign.startNotice: Start and resume execute model calls using the saved accounts and consume their quota. Pause lets the current workflow finish. Cancellation is final; reserved cases remain reserved.
campaign.research: Research results only. These results do not enable automatic model selection in chats or waves.
